Keyboard state is written only by its explicit button and Escape command. Existing ordering/cancellation and pointer-mask regressions remain green. Native source/binaries and permissions unchanged.

0.1.66: 56 target controller/model/platform tests passed. TV and integrated Vision gestures reserve the existing platform inputQueue through their full done lifetime; discrete actions finish only previously accepted gestures synchronously before enqueueing. This consolidates both input directions without a new queue or retry. Thirty-six discrete/gesture/discrete interleavings cover press/key/paste, TV wheel and Vision pointer/wheel/toolbar camera, before the first API starts or while it is pending, normal release, cancellation and rejection. The old implementation first reproduced the out-of-order began failure. Existing reverse-order, cross-page, mouse-edge and cancellation regressions pass. Native source/binaries and permissions unchanged.

Task messages combine the upstream name with required iOS/tvOS/visionOS runtime guidance. The rebase introduces no change to spatial/native input, queue ownership or permissions.

0.1.64: 55 controller/model/platform regressions passed. Cross-page fixtures execute real control.js capture listeners before real platform/Vision handlers. Parent/frame TV remote shortcuts, toolbar buttons and Home wait for began/changed/ended acknowledgement and all accepted swipe motion; cancellation/failure invalidate pending presses. Remote mouse-down preserves device focus. Vision frame Cmd/Ctrl+S, Shift+H, +, -, 0 and 1 reach the device with modifiers while capture is on; viewer shortcuts remain active outside the frame and when capture is off, and Escape exits capture. Missing platform controller does not fall back to direct device input. Both original cross-page findings failed against 0.1.63 before the fix. Existing device queue owns all toolbar press delivery; no new queue, native change or permission.

0.1.63: 52 controller/model/platform regressions passed. TV ending intent is explicit (normal finish versus cancel), and normal queued swipes no longer expire silently by age. Six success interleavings delay began/changed/ended by 101/1001 ms while three short swipes and a following Back action are accepted; every swipe retains began/motion/ended order before Back. Existing cancellation/failure interleavings remain green. The success regression first failed on 0.1.62. Rebased main be48e71 (#201), retaining first-connect presentation and both upstream/review tests. Native source/binaries and permissions unchanged.

0.1.62: 30 controller/spatial regressions passed. One ordered sample queue preserves per-button-mask displacement before each edge and zero-displacement button transitions before subsequent motion. Eight delayed began/changed interleavings cover both first buttons, event/move-reported mask changes, partial/all releases and normal end; the regression failed against 0.1.61 and against an incomplete edge-coalescing implementation. Rebased onto main 1ef61f4 (#204), retaining the old-iPhone Home placement fix. Native source/binaries are unchanged in this round.

0.1.61: 29 browser/controller regression tests passed. TV and Vision cancellation now cover all unfinished contacts and queued discrete input. Pointer tests cover both left/right button orderings, button changes delivered by pointermove, fast edges while an acknowledgement is pending, partial release, cancellation of pending edges, and 120000/-60000 pixel cumulative motion. Six issue/cross-input regressions were first reproduced against the old implementation.

0.1.61 native protocol regression executes the production stream loop with stub HID and a fast clock: 2101 changed samples (2521200/-1260600 pixels), held-mask transitions, final release, malformed-input release, and preserved spatial coordinate/time limits pass. Native pointer offsets use the same finite +/-1e9 limit as Node; the pointer mode is exempt from the spatial 20 s/2000-sample cap while EOF/750 ms/SIGTERM release stays. spatial.m was rebuilt with Xcode 27.1 (27A9269), ad-hoc signed and signature-verified. This is protocol isolation, not new guest or installed-Cindy acceptance.

The only rebase conflict was manifest metadata; all Vision controls and input/OCR review fixes are retained. TV/Vision default/full/point/query/role modes execute OCR with visible/empty/failure cases; modified Cmd/Ctrl+Left/Right (including Shift) rotate iOS only and pass through TV/Vision.
